title: Gifted-education advisor assigns ESP, crop circles and abduction stories
summary: Deep Prasad tells of Gifted-education advisor assigns ESP, crop circles and abduction stories, about Deep Prasad's childhood at Deep Prasad's school, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I was consistently being assigned ESP. Eventually evolved into crop circles. She's like looking to abduction stories.

plain: Deep Prasad, a researcher in technology, says that as a child in a school program for gifted students, his advisor kept assigning him topics like ESP, short for extrasensory perception, meaning psychic abilities. He says the assignments later moved on to crop circles, patterns that appear flattened into fields, and then to stories of people being abducted by aliens. He tells it as an early, unusual push toward these subjects.
